Game Overview

In MOLE.X, the core idea is straightforward: catch mischievous moles in MOLE.X, a retro pixel game demanding sharp reflexes and pinpoint accuracy. With visuals evoking nostalgia and increasingly rapid gameplay, every missed mole edges you closer to defeat. Perfect your timing for precision scoring, and embrace the exhilarating challenge of focused mole-catching frenzy.
